==Walkthrough==
===Memories of a "Friend"===
{{Needed|Combat gear, some food, [[ivandis flail]] or [[blisterwood flail]], [[Saw]], one dose of [[anti-venom]] or two doses of [[antipoison]]|recommended=[[Ectophial]] for fast access to [[Port Phasmatys]], [[Drakan's medallion]], [[Super energy]] or [[Stamina potions]]}}
{{Checklist|
*Talk to the [[Mysterious Stranger]] by the entrance to the [[Theatre of Blood]].
**''No Theatre of Blood raids completed:''{{Chat option|2What's all this really about?|1Yes.}}
**''Completed at least 1 Theatre of Blood raid:''{{Chat option|1Speaking of your associates, what's all this really about?|1Yes.}}
*Go down the stairs to the north-east of the Mysterious Stranger. Bring a [[saw]] and [[blisterwood flail]].
*Kill a [[vyrewatch]] for a key.
*Unlock the gate to the south and open the coffin.
*Return to the Mysterious Stranger with [[Ranis' head]] and watch the cutscene. {{Chat option|1Yes.}}
*Go to the [[Morytania Spider Cave|dungeon (cave)]] north of [[Darkmeyer]] (south of [[Port Phasmatys]]).
*Follow the path north, then east to the egg sac.
*Search the nearby skeleton.
*Read the [[sticky note]].
*Speak to [[Daer Krand]] {{Chat option|3Got any sulphuric acid?}} in the [[Sisterhood Sanctuary]] to obtain [[sulphuric acid]]. 
**The entrance is located south of the graveyard in Slepe.
**To reach Daer Krand, make your way toward the centre of the sanctuary, then follow the path east, then north. He is located upstairs.
*Return to the dungeon (cave) north of Darkmeyer.
*Use [[sulphuric acid]] on the egg sac. You do not need to kill any spiders.
**The spiders here can [[envenom]] you. Drink a dose of [[anti-venom]] or two doses of [[anti-poison]] to cure it.
*Return to the Mysterious Stranger {{Chat option|1I found some of those eggs.}} with the [[strange spider eggs]]. Watch two cutscenes.
}}

===In Touch with Nature===
{{Needed|[[Ghostspeak amulet]] or [[Morytania legs]] 2+, any [[axe]], equipment and food to kill a level 302 [[Hespori (A Night at the Theatre)|hespori]]|recommended=[[Dramen staff]] for fast travel to the Grotto, [[Super combat potion]], [[Antipoison]], [[Drakan's medallion]], [[Druid pouch]] or a lit [[Fire of Dehumidification]] to protect food from [[ghast]]s}}
{{Checklist|
*With [[ghostspeak amulet]] or [[Morytania legs 2]]+ (and [[druid pouch]] to protect food), go to the [[Nature Grotto]] (fairy ring {{fairycode|BIP}}), and speak to the Nature Spirit [[Filliman Tarlock]] inside the grotto. 
*Go to the island on the east side of Mort Myre (directly east of the grotto, just west of [[Castle Drakan]]).
**Look for the island north of the [[Shades of Mort'ton (minigame)|Shades of Mort'ton]] minigame symbol.
*Cross the stepping stone and kill the [[Hespori (A Night at the Theatre)|hespori]] and chop it afterwards to obtain [[hespori bark]].
*Return to the Mysterious Stranger. {{Chat option|1I found a hespori.}} Watch two cutscenes.
}}

===Theatre of Blood===
'''''Note:''''' ''If you have completed the Theatre of Blood before (any mode), you will be given the option to skip this section.''{{Main|Theatre of Blood/Strategies}}
{{Needed|High-level combat gear of all styles, a method to inflict poison, food, potions, etc. to do a [[Theatre of Blood]] raid if never completed one, optionally more party members if you have trouble alone}}
{{Checklist|
*Complete a [[Theatre of Blood]] raid (any mode works, although entry mode is recommended). See [[Theatre of Blood/Strategies|this page]] for details on mechanics of the bosses.
*Talk to the [[Mysterious Stranger]] again after completing the raid. Watch two cutscenes.
*'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''
}}
